---
title: "2022 Florida Gubernatorial Election"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(maps)

county_data <- read_csv("data/20221108__fl__general__county.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

gov_results <- county_data |>
  filter(office == "Governor", party %in% c("REP", "DEM")) |>
  select(county, party, votes) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = party, values_from = votes) |>
  mutate(
    total = REP + DEM,
    rep_pct = round((REP / total) * 100, 1),
    dem_pct = round((DEM / total) * 100, 1),
    rep_margin = rep_pct - dem_pct,
    clean_county = str_to_lower(str_remove_all(county, "[^a-zA-Z]")),
    tooltip_text = paste0(
      "<b>", county, " County</b><br>",
      "DeSantis (REP): ", scales::comma(REP), " (", rep_pct, "%)<br>",
      "Crist (DEM): ", scales::comma(DEM), " (", dem_pct, "%)<br>",
      "Margin: ", ifelse(rep_margin > 0, paste0("+", round(rep_margin, 1), "% R"), paste0("+", round(abs(rep_margin), 1), "% D"))
    )
  )

fl_map <- map_data("county", "florida") |>
  mutate(clean_county = str_to_lower(str_remove_all(subregion, "[^a-zA-Z]"))) |>
  left_join(gov_results, by = "clean_county")

p <- ggplot(fl_map, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = rep_margin, text = tooltip_text)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166ac",
    mid = "#f7f7f7",
    high = "#b2182b",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Margin (%)"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(
    title = "2022 Florida Gubernatorial Election Results by County"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5)
  )

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(visible = FALSE, showgrid = FALSE),
    yaxis = list(visible = FALSE, showgrid = FALSE)
  )
```
